q: If I had more money, ____________________.
o: I would travel around the world
I would have traveled around the world
I will travel around the world
I would had travel around the world

q: If she had returned the money in time, I ________ a case.
Complete the sentence: He talks as though _____ .
Complete the following sentence : "If I had studied harder, I _____________the exam".
Had we known the truth, we __________ a different decision.
If I had seen him, I _____ him.
If you mix hydrogen and oxygen, you ________ water.
e: এটি zero conditional, যা বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য বা সব সময় সত্য এমন বিষয়ে ব্যবহৃত হয়। গঠন: If + present simple, present simple। তাই হাইড্রোজেন ও অক্সিজেন মেশালে পানি পাওয়া যায়, এই সত্য বোঝাতে you get water হবে। Would get বা got বা will get অন্য conditional বা কালের গঠন, তাই এখানে চলে না।

q: If Alex ___ me, I will email the documents. (BU 15-16)
e: First Conditional-এ If-clause বর্তমানে থাকে (Present Indefinite) এবং main clause-এ will + base verb বসে। If-clause-এ will বসে না, তাই asks সঠিক। অর্থ: অ্যালেক্স আমাকে বললে আমি কাগজপত্র ইমেইল করে দেব। Will ask ও will tell if-clause-এ বসে না। Has asked চলতে পারে, কিন্তু এই ছাঁচে সরল Present Indefinite-ই সবচেয়ে স্বাভাবিক।

q: If they had invited me, I ______ the party.
It is high time (do) the work.
e: এখানে time-এর পরে কোনো কর্তা নেই, তাই It is high time-এর পরে to-infinitive বসে: to do। অর্থ: কাজটা করার সময় হয়ে গেছে। did বসাতে হলে আগে কর্তা লাগত (It is high time he did the work)। doing ও does এই কাঠামোতে বসে না। নিয়ম: কর্তা থাকলে past verb, কর্তা না থাকলে to + verb।

q: Identify the correct one from the following sentence:
o: Had I seen him, I would tell him the matter.
Had I seen him, I would told him the matter.
Had I seen him, I would have tell him the matter.
Had I seen him, I would have told him the matter.

q: Identify the correct sentence:
o: Were I to refuse they'd have been very annoyed.
Were I to refuse they'd be very annoyed.
If I were to refuse they'd have very annoyed.
If I were to refuse will be very annoyed.

q: Select the sentence with appropriate form:
o: If Salina had the money, she would bought a fast car.
It would be nice if the weather is been better.
If I was you, I would patted your jacket on.
If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
e: ‘If I knew the answer, I would tell you’ বাক্যটি second conditional-এর শুদ্ধ রূপ। এই গঠনে if-clause-এ past simple এবং main clause-এ would + verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে, যা বর্তমানের কাল্পনিক অবস্থা বোঝায়। ক-তে ‘would bought’ ভুল, হবে would buy। খ-তে ‘is been’ অশুদ্ধ, হবে were better। গ-তে ‘would patted’ ভুল, আর আনুষ্ঠানিক ইংরেজিতে ‘If I was you’ না বলে ‘If I were you’ বলা হয়। পরীক্ষায় প্রায়ই আসে যে third conditional-এ গঠন হয় If + had + past participle, would have + past participle, যেমন If I had known, I would have told you।

q: He told the matter as if he ________ it.
Q. (9-11): Complete the sentences with the best possible solution, if any. 9) The more she worked, _______
e: 'The more …, the less …' একটি তুলনামূলক গঠন, যেখানে দুই অংশেই the + comparative বসে, তাই The more she worked, the less she achieved সঠিক। এর অর্থ সে যত বেশি কাজ করল, তত কম অর্জন করল, অর্থাৎ একটির পরিবর্তনে অন্যটি আনুপাতিকভাবে বদলায়। অন্য অপশনগুলোতে দ্বিতীয় অংশে 'the + comparative' নেই, তাই বাক্য অসম্পূর্ণ ও ব্যাকরণগতভাবে ভুল। একই গঠনের পরিচিত উদাহরণ: The more you read, the more you learn।

q: If I had known about the traffic, _____________.
o: I would have taken a different route
I have taken a different route
I would take a different route

q: He spells the words as if he _____ a student of kindergarten.
Pick the right word to complete the sentence: She cried as if she ______ hurt badly.
It is high time to _________ the enemy.
e: It is high time বা It is time-এর পরে সরাসরি to থাকলে verb-এর base form বসে, তাই to attack। আর এর পরে নতুন subject এলে সেই subject-এর verb past form হয়। উদাহরণ: It is high time we gave up smoking; It is high time to change our attitude. বাক্যের অর্থ: শত্রুকে আক্রমণ করার এখনই সময়।

q: If humans were totally deprived of sleep, they_______ hallucination, anxiety, coma, and eventually, death.
